pain: Design and access statements and planning documents are tedious and badly done

verdict: Low fees, commodity work, and the wrong buyer. Weakest shape in the architecture cluster.

why.distribution: Directly reachable, and applications are constant.
why.demand: Practices do outsource this, usually to cheap freelancers.
why.fmf: She can produce these to a high standard, though it uses little of her rare skill.
why.defensibility: Freelancers and AI both do this cheaply.
why.ceiling: £1,400 x 140 applications = £196k, which is three applications a week indefinitely.

ceiling_arithmetic: £1,400 x 140 applications = £196k, requiring nearly three completed applications every week. Impossible part-time. Realistic: 30-40 = £42-56k.
carries: Immediate cash and an easy sale.
kills: Structurally capped. The fee is too low for any volume she can physically deliver.
test_fail: They name a freelancer at £400 - the likely answer.
